description: Machine-readable producer/consumer compatibility matrix for the ADR-0073 envelope (GT-174). Each surface declares the envelope schemaVersion(s) it currently produces and the consumer schemaVersion ranges it accepts. CI validates against surface-compatibility.schema.json, asserts source constants match the producer entries here, and rejects any multi-version produces list missing an explicit migration entry per consecutive transition.

rest.notes: REST envelope built by EnvelopeInterceptor; error path wraps RFC 9457 Problem Details under error.details.

cli.notes: Canonical OutputMeta shared by sdk/cli commands (gate, phase-advance).

mcp.notes: MCP tool result envelope. Field set differs from the canonical OutputMeta (uses `tool` and `timestamp`), but `schemaVersion` follows the same pinning discipline.
